background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Fitch rates the holding company A on a positive outlook, S&P BBB+ and Moody's A3, both stable; the last move was S&P's downgrade to BBB+ on 2 Dec 2015. Consolidated capital is on the weak side against US peers: CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% are both below the peer median, with leverage down 0.4 points since 30 Sep 2025, while LCR of 117% sits at the median. The flagged news is conduct, led by the UK fine for Russia sanctions breaches on 3 Sep 2026, small against the balance sheet. Fitch's positive outlook is the one sign of direction.
